target_customer: QA testers and non-engineers at software teams who need web app tests without writing Selenium or Cypress code
problem: Writing and maintaining Selenium or Cypress end-to-end tests is slow and brittle. Preflight offers no-code test creation with self-healing selectors, chained workflows and API tests generated from UI network calls.

founders.name: Mustafa Bayramoglu
prior_employers: ShipBob (first engineer, grew engineering team from 1 to 40+)
education: Master's degree in high-performance computing (school not named)
founders.background_notes: Sole founder listed on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Record and replay plus selector self-healing and dependent test workflows is standard engineering with some hard parts, built by a team of about five per the YC page.

defensibility.rationale: Codeless testing tools already existed and the speed claim is a vendor claim. No data or network effects are evidenced.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Applitools bought Preflight on 2023-06-29 to reach non-coding testers with its Visual AI; terms undisclosed.

market_need_then: The founder said his team wrote about 100 Selenium tests in two months and could not maintain them within weeks (a secondary profile quoting him), which points to maintenance pain in end to end testing.

branding.domain_note: preflight.com was the company domain; it now redirects to a GoDaddy for-sale page.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand found. The name is a recognisable aviation checklist metaphor but generic and shared with other products.

outcome_analysis: Preflight was a small Chicago team that went through YC in Winter 2019 and later sold to Applitools in June 2023 with undisclosed terms; Calcalist reported a figure of 10 to 15 million dollars which is unconfirmed. Funding is only visible in aggregators that disagree, so the capital story cannot be judged. The exit looks like a product and team acquisition by a larger testing vendor wanting no-code reach rather than a venture-scale outcome.
notes: Aggregators (Bouncewatch, Village.ai, Employbl) list a seed of 1.2M or 2.08M in 2021 and about 150K YC money in 2019, with totals of 2.2 to 2.3M. These are unverified and not recorded as rounds. Investor names Hyde Park, M25, OCA and Grand Ventures were not confirmed in a second source. The deal value of 10 to 15M comes from Calcalist via a search summary and is unverified. The company site is dead (redirects to a domain sale page). No dated competitor source found near the 2019 batch, so the list is empty.
